# 美股周评 · 2026-09-26：指数反弹，参与面没有跟上

对应周六期次 2026-09-26 · 数据截至 2026-09-25 · 历史回顾补编

正式编号：RI-WR-2026-W39；制作日期：2026-10-02；修订版 v1.1；作者：Sunny。

## 本期判断
本周 SPY 上涨 1.27%，广度却降至 44.73%。参与度风险升至 66.9，脆弱性升至 96.1。综合分数为 63.4，仍属谨慎；反弹尚不足以支持提高整体风险敞口。

## 本周市场

| 观测指标 | 上一期 | 本期 | 变化 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 综合分数 | 61.06 | 63.36 | +2.30 分 |
| 市场宽度 | 46.40% | 44.73% | -1.66 个百分点 |
| 金融压力 | 33.33 | 33.33 | +0.00 分 |
| 市场脆弱性 | 92.93 | 96.08 | +3.15 分 |
| 市场风险 | 60.98 | 57.14 | -3.84 分 |
| 参与度风险 | 56.99 | 66.90 | +9.91 分 |

周频模型：Level 4，参考风险仓位 50%；信号日期 2026-09-18。综合状态与广度截至 2026-09-25。[1]

截至 9 月 25 日，SPY 从 761.69 回升至 771.35，周度涨幅为 1.27%。与此同时，广度从 46.40% 降至 44.73%，继续收缩。指数反弹与参与面走弱同时发生，反弹的覆盖范围仍然有限。[1][2]

参与度风险升至 66.9，进入防御区间；市场风险回落至 57.1，仍为谨慎。脆弱性进一步升至 96.1，而金融压力保持在 33.3。当前压力仍主要来自股市内部，高脆弱性与弱参与并未随着指数上涨而消失。[1]

## 反弹之后，继续看广度

综合分数由 61.1 升至 63.4，继续处于谨慎区间。市场风险回落是一个改善，但参与度风险已进入防御，整体结构并未转好。模型仍给出 Level 4、50% 的参考风险仓位，当前维持谨慎比追随指数反弹更有依据。

9 月加息后的目标利率为 3.75%-4.00%。[3] 金融压力暂时温和，说明政策收紧尚未在这项指标中表现为融资压力的明显恶化。接下来重点看反弹能否扩散，以及高脆弱性是否回落；如果只是少数股票维持指数，而广度继续下降，风险判断仍需保持谨慎。

## 继续关注

| 方向 | 观察内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 反弹扩散 | 价格与广度共同回升，参与度风险回落。 |
| 风险状态 | 跟踪综合分数与脆弱性，留意是否进一步进入防御区间。 |
| 新增数据 | 9 月 30 日发布的 8 月 PCE 留待下一期讨论，本期截止到 9 月 25 日。 |

## 数据口径

观察区间：2026-09-18 至 2026-09-25。模型指标采用当期存档版本，SPY 价格采用 2026-10-02 提取的冻结记录。[1][2]

广度为有效美股样本中价格高于 200 日均线的占比，样本覆盖范围可变；不是标普 500 专属广度。历史分母未完整保存。

SPY 周度变动按复权收盘价计算，未另行重建分红再投资；文中价格变动不是策略回报。[2]

综合状态按原始分数划分：<35 建设性，35-<50 中性，50-<65 谨慎，65-<80 防御，≥80 压力。低频组件与周频风险信号可能滞后；模型分数不表示危机概率。

本稿为历史回顾，编制于 2026-10-02。v1.1 修改文字，保留原数据版本；截图与后来重算的序列可能存在差异。

## 资料限制

本稿以美股内部结构为主，SPY 用作指数价格代理。未进行事件因果分析，也未纳入截止日之后公布的数据。

存档质量检查通过，源时效标签为 stale。信号日期见正文；通过质量检查不代表数据均已更新。

## This week in markets

| Measure | Previous | Current | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Composite score | 61.06 | 63.36 | +2.30 points |
| Market breadth | 46.40% | 44.73% | -1.66 pp |
| Financial stress | 33.33 | 33.33 | +0.00 points |
| Fragility | 92.93 | 96.08 | +3.15 points |
| Market risk | 60.98 | 57.14 | -3.84 points |
| Participation risk | 56.99 | 66.90 | +9.91 points |

Weekly model: Level 4, 50% reference risk exposure; signal date 2026-09-18. Composite and breadth observations end 2026-09-25.[1]

As of September 25, SPY recovered from 761.69 to 771.35, a weekly gain of 1.27%. Meanwhile, breadth fell from 46.40% to 44.73%, continuing to contract. The index rebound coincided with weaker participation, leaving the recovery limited in scope.[1][2]

Participation risk rose to 66.9, entering Defensive. Market risk eased to 57.1 but remained Caution. Fragility increased further to 96.1 while financial stress stayed at 33.3. Pressure remained primarily internal to equities: elevated fragility and weak participation did not disappear as the index rose.[1]

## After the rebound, keep watching breadth

The composite score rose from 61.1 to 63.4, remaining Caution. Lower market risk was an improvement, but participation risk had entered Defensive and overall structure had not improved. The model still indicated Level 4 with a 50% reference risk exposure. Maintaining caution has more support than simply following the index rebound.

The target range after the September hike was 3.75%-4.00%.[3] Financial stress remained moderate: tighter policy had not yet produced a clear deterioration in financing stress under this indicator. Watch whether the rebound broadens and elevated fragility eases. If a few stocks hold up the index while breadth keeps declining, the risk interpretation should remain cautious.

## What to watch

| Area | Observation |
| --- | --- |
| Rebound diffusion | Look for prices and breadth improving together, with lower participation risk. |
| Risk state | Track the composite and fragility, including whether the composite moves further into Defensive. |
| New data | The August PCE release on September 30 is reserved for the next issue; this report ends September 25. |

## Data and methodology

Observation window: 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-25. Model readings use the archived vintage for that period. SPY prices use records frozen on October 2, 2026.[1][2]

Breadth is the proportion of eligible U.S. equities trading above their 200-day moving averages. Coverage varies; this is not S&P 500-only breadth. Historical denominators were not fully preserved.

Weekly SPY price changes use adjusted closes. Dividend reinvestment was not independently reconstructed; these changes are not strategy returns.[2]

Composite states use the unrounded score: below 35 Constructive; 35 to below 50 Neutral; 50 to below 65 Caution; 65 to below 80 Defensive; 80 or above Stress. Lower-frequency components and weekly signals can lag. Scores are not crisis probabilities.

This is a retrospective prepared on October 2, 2026, not a publication made during the historical week. Version 1.1 revised commentary while retaining the original data vintage. Screenshots and subsequently recalculated histories may differ.

## Limitations

This report focuses on internal U.S. equity-market structure and uses SPY as an index price proxy. It does not perform event-level causal analysis or incorporate releases after the observation cutoff.

Archived quality checks passed; the source freshness label was stale. Signal dates are stated separately. Passing quality checks does not mean that all inputs have been updated.

## Disclosure

Prepared by Residual Inertia | 余势 for research and information only. This is not investment or securities-trading advice. Model outputs do not represent actual account holdings. The report does not disclose the author's holdings or conflicts of interest.
